verdict.rationale: Warp states that it does not allow OpenAI or Anthropic to use your data for model training, and that terminal input/output is never stored on its servers. Business and Enterprise plans add a Zero Data Retention agreement under which no AI interaction or console data is collected, and paid plans can opt out of telemetry while still using AI. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training guarantee for the other model providers it offers (Gemini, open-weight models like Kimi/Qwen), any user-facing training-opt-out control, and independent corroboration of the no-training policy.
